blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Urban environments are shaped by design choices with long-term implications for health, safety, and quality of life, yet evaluating proposed interventions remains costly, time-consuming, and often impractical.
Existing geospatial vision methods largely focus on monitoring urban indicators from aerial and street-view imagery, rather than proposing interventions and estimating their effects on such indicators.
Moving beyond recognition, we introduce the problem of discovering interventions that improve target indicators for a given aerial or street-view image.
We argue that a black-box indicator model, combined with a generative editing model, can serve as an implicit digital twin for testing intervention hypotheses.
We present VIDA-Geo , a multi-agent system that explores this intervention space by coordinating segmentation, diffusion-based inpainting, and indicator scoring models to produce interventions that are both perceptually realistic and aligned with real-world policies.
We evaluate our system on 8 indicators across aerial and street-view imagery, measuring changes in factors such as perceived safety and greenery.
Our approach outperforms existing baselines in many cases, achieving up to 2 × 2\times higher perceptual quality and policy alignment scores.
Finally, our model provides users with multiple candidate interventions, supporting an expert city-planner-in-the-loop workflow. Code is available at https://github.com/HosamGen/VIDA-GEO
blocks.zh:
城市环境是由设计选择形成的,对健康、安全和生活质量具有长期影响,但评价拟议干预措施的费用仍然很高,耗费时间,而且往往不切实际。
现有的地理空间愿景方法主要侧重于从空中和街景图像监测城市指标,而不是提出干预措施并估计其对这些指标的影响。
超越认知,我们提出了发现改善特定空中或街景图像目标指标的干预措施的问题。
我们争辩说,黑盒指标模型同基因编辑模型相结合,可以作为测试干预假设的隐含数字双胞胎.
我们介绍VIDA-Geo系统,这是一个多代理系统,它通过协调分块、基于传播的印花和指标评分模型来探索这一干预空间,以产生既具有观念又符合现实世界政策的干预。
我们通过航空和街景图像的8个指标评估我们的系统,衡量各种因素的变化,如所认为的安全和绿色。
在许多情况下,我们的做法优于现有基线,达到最高2×2分,提高认知质量和政策协调分数。
最后,我们的模式为用户提供了多个候选干预,支持专家的城市规划人员在即工作流程。 代码见https://github.com/HosamGen/VIDA-GEO。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Visual geospatial data is used in several real-world applications for monitoring and decision-making.
Urban planners make use of satellite images to monitor various indicators such as road safety ( Cha et al., 2025 , Elallaf et al., 2026 ) and greenery ( Rahaman et al., 2024 ) .
Similarly, climate scientists make use of satellite images to understand pollution ( Guo et al., 2025 , Porcheddu et al., 2025 ) , perceived temperatures ( Ke et al., 2025 , Briegel et al., 2024 ) and thermal exposure ( Zaerpour et al., 2025 , Dousset et al., 2011 ) .
Beyond satellite images, experts also make use of other visual information, such as street view imagery or surveillance footage, to monitor perceived safety ( Zhang et al., 2024 , Liu et al., 2023 ) , road-safety ( Yu et al., 2024 , Wei et al., 2025 ) , or walkability ( Berriel et al., 2017 , Nadai et al., 2016 ) .
blocks.zh:
视觉地理空间数据被用于几个现实世界的应用,用于监测和决策.
城市规划者利用卫星图像监测各种指标,如道路安全(Cha等,2025年;Elallaf等,2026年;和绿化(Rahaman等,2024年)。
同样,气候科学家利用卫星图像了解污染(Guo等,2025年;Porcheddu等,2025年;Ke等,2025年;Briegel等,2024年;)和热接触(Zaerpour等,2025年;Dousest等,2011年)。
除卫星图像外,专家还利用其他视觉信息,如街景图像或监控镜头来监测感知安全(张等,2024,刘等,2023),道路安全(于等,2024,魏等,2025),或可步行性(Berriel等,2017,Nadai等,2016).

blocks.en:
Computer vision research on such visual geospatial data has primarily focused on improving recognition, and consequently, we see highly performing models for many of the aforementioned tasks.
However, monitoring via recognition systems is only half of the story.
The goal of such planners and scientists is not just to monitor indicators but to intervene when necessary and make changes in accordance with policies.
For example, an urban planner might suggest that a particular street is perceived as unsafe due to the presence of scaffolding, and therefore, based on the city’s policy, the scaffolding must be replaced with safer scaffolding.
While monitoring is well explored, identifying such recommendations remains underexplored.
blocks.zh:
关于这种视觉地理空间数据的计算机远景研究主要侧重于提高认知,因此,我们看到上述许多任务的高效模式。
然而,通过识别系统进行监测只是故事的一半。
这些规划者和科学家的目标不仅仅是监测指标,而是在必要时进行干预并依照政策作出改变。
例如,城市规划人员可能暗示,由于脚手架的存在,特定街道被视为不安全,因此根据城市政策,脚手架必须被更安全的脚手架所取代.
虽然对监测工作进行了充分探讨,但这些建议的确定仍然没有得到充分利用。

blocks.en:
Moving beyond visual monitoring, we propose a new framework for visual intervention for decision support .
Given an input geospatial image of a region, such as an aerial or street view image, and a black-box indicator prediction model, such as road safety, our framework outputs realistic interventions to the image that improve the indicator score.
Our framework could aid policymakers in domains such as urban planning or climate science by providing a diverse set of interventions before implementing interventions in the real world (see fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
除了目视监测之外,我们提议一个新的目视干预框架,以支持决策。
鉴于一个区域的输入地理空间图像,如空中或街景图像,以及一个黑箱指标预测模型,如道路安全,我们的框架对改善指标分数的图像提供了现实的干预。
我们的框架可以帮助城市规划或气候科学等领域的决策者,在现实世界实施干预措施之前提供一套不同的干预措施(见图一)。 (第1条)

blocks.en:
Figure 1: Given a geospatial image (street view or aerial), a user can ask VIDA-Geo to suggest interventions that improve a target indicator, such as liveliness.
Our system proposes multiple realistic, policy-grounded interventions to support decision-making.
The user can then choose the intervention most suitable for their use case.
blocks.zh:
图1:鉴于地理空间图像(街景或空中),用户可以请VIDA-Geo提出改善目标指标的干预措施,如活性。

用户然后可以选择最适合其使用的干预.

blocks.en:
The current paradigm for finding interventions in urban planning is to run simulations in digital twins of a city ( Herzog et al., 2025 , Ghaffarian, 2025 ) .
However, this has several challenges: 1) they require regular and expensive data collection to maintain the digital twin, 2) the verification of interventions requires expensive and time-consuming simulations, and 3) they could only model specific types of interventions depending on the simulation model.
blocks.zh:
目前在城市规划中寻找干预措施的模式是在城市的数码双胞胎中进行模拟(Herzog等,2025年;Ghaffarian,2025年)。
然而,这有几项挑战: 1)它们需要定期和昂贵的数据收集来维持数字双胞胎,2)对干预的核查需要昂贵和耗时的模拟,3)它们只能根据模拟模型来模拟特定类型的干预.

blocks.en:
We instead posit that, rather than creating expensive digital twins, a combination of an indicator monitoring model (recognition) and an image editing model (generative model) can serve as an implicit digital twin (IDT) for creating such interventions. Indicator recognition/monitoring models ( Naik et al., 2014 , Larkin et al., 2021 ) have been shown to be highly accurate.
Moreover, as we show in the results (see fig. 8 ), they are also good at handling counterfactuals, which is an important requirement to be treated as a component of an implicit digital twin.
However, a prediction model alone cannot serve as an IDT, as it cannot generate interventions.
Modern generative models have both realistic generation capabilities and controllable editing ( Rombach et al., 2022 , Wang et al., 2025 ) , including in domains such as satellite imagery ( Cher et al., 2025 , Sastry et al., 2024 ) .
Therefore, we use generative editing models to generate realistic interventions.
blocks.zh:
相反,我们假定,一个指标监测模型(识别)和一个图像编辑模型(基因模型)的结合,与其创造出昂贵的数字双胞胎,不如成为创建此类干预措施的隐含数字双胞胎。 显示指标识别/监测模型(Naik等,2014年;Larkin等,2021年)高度准确。
此外,正如我们在结果(见图8)中所表明的那样,它们也擅长处理反事实,而反事实是作为隐性数字双胞胎的组成部分处理的一项重要要求。
然而,一个预测模型本身不能作为IDT,因为它不能产生干预。
现代基因模型既具有现实的生成能力和可控制的编辑能力(Rombach等,2022年;Wang等,2025年),包括卫星图像等领域(Cher等,2025年;Sastry等,2024年).
因此,我们使用基因编辑模型来产生现实的干预.

blocks.en:
However, one key question remains: how do we propose realistic interventions that can actually be deployed in the real world, rather than simply optimizing the indicator score?
To ensure that interventions are grounded from a policymaker’s perspective, we use large language models (LLMs) for intervention proposals.
Specifically, we introduce a multi-agent system with several sub-agents.
We start with a high-level planner agent that, given an image, identifies regions of interest (ROIs) that can potentially be intervened upon.
The ROIs, along with the image, are passed to a policy sub-agent , which uses real-world knowledge to suggest realistic interventions in the ROIs.
These ROIs are also passed to a segmentation agent , which uses several foundation models to find relevant masks for intervention.
The generation sub-agent then uses these prompts to generate realistic edits.
The edited images are evaluated both for improvement in the black-box indicator score and for whether they remain grounded in the goals of the policy agent .
All trials are kept in memory and passed back to the planner agent , which decides the next set of ROIs.
Framing this as a multi-agent system allows interventions to be regionally and policy-grounded while remaining modular and understandable to experts.
We call this a multi-agent system VIDA-Geo ( V isual I ntervention and D ecision-support A gent for Geo spatial data).
blocks.zh:
然而,一个关键问题仍然是:我们如何提出现实的干预措施,这些干预措施实际上可以部署在现实世界,而不是简单地优化指标得分?
为了确保干预以决策者的观点为基础,我们使用大语言模式进行干预建议。
具体来说,我们引入了多剂系统,并配有多个子剂.
我们从一个高级别规划人员开始,从形象出发,确定可以进行干预的感兴趣区域。
ROI与图像一起传递给一个政策副代理人,后者利用现实世界的知识建议在ROI中进行现实的干预.
这些ROI也传递给分块剂,
生成子代理然后使用这些提示来生成现实的编辑.
对经过编辑的图像进行评价,既是为了改善黑盒指标得分,也是为了使其仍然以政策代理人的目标为基础。
所有审判都保存在记忆中,并转回计划代理人,由规划代理人决定下一套ROI.
将这一系统编为多代理系统,可以使干预措施具有区域性和政策基础,同时保持模块化,并为专家所理解。
我们称之为多剂系统VIDA-Geo(地球空间数据的V等分I正反和D精密支持A正反)。

blocks.en:
To evaluate our method and future works on this problem, we introduce a new benchmark with evaluation metrics for these 8 tasks.
We show that our agentic method can find realistic and grounded interventions by testing it on satellite and street view images across 8 indicator tasks.
Our main contributions are as follows. • We introduce a new problem setup that moves beyond geospatial monitoring towards intervention for policy-based decision-making. • We provide a new benchmark for evaluating this task, with evaluation metrics that measure the realism of interventions from both image-based and policy-oriented perspectives. • We introduce a multi-agent system VIDA-Geo , that proposes, executes, and quantitatively evaluates geospatial interventions. We frame this system as an Implicit Digital Twin and show that it outperforms methods related to this problem setting.
blocks.zh:
为了评估我们的方法和未来在这个问题上的工作,我们为这8项任务引入了新的基准,并附有评价尺度。
我们显示,通过在卫星和街景图像上进行测试,我们的代理方法能够发现现实和有根据的干预措施,涉及8项指标任务。
我们的主要贡献如下。 我们提出了一个新的问题,从地理空间监测转向干预基于政策的决策。 我们为评价这项任务提供了新的基准,并制定了评价尺度,从以形象为基础和以政策为导向的角度衡量干预措施的现实性。 我们引入了一个多代理系统VIDA-Geo, 提出、执行和定量评估地理空间干预措施。 我们将此系统设定为隐形数字双子系统,并显示它的表现超过了与这一问题设定相关的方法.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
Urban Indicator Estimation Overhead-images have been used for safety and mobility indicators, including crash-risk signals ( Najjar et al., 2017 , He et al., 2021 , Elallaf et al., 2026 ) and pedestrian-network extraction through sidewalks ( Hosseini et al., 2023 , Nadai et al., 2016 ) .
Segmentation methods ( Xia et al., 2023 , Demir et al., 2018 ) have also been used to measure vegetation ( Li et al., 2015 , Wolch et al., 2014 ) .
Street-view imagery has been widely used to study perceived urban qualities such as safety and liveliness ( Dubey et al., 2016 , Hou et al., 2024 , Naik et al., 2014 ) .
Recent work also uses it to model human perceptions ( Danish et al., 2025 , Hamim & Ukkusuri, 2024 ) and for multimodal LLM-based evaluation ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) .
While such models are well established, we use them to measure and guide visual interventions that improve an indicator score at a given place.

最近的工作还用来模拟人类的认知(丹麦等,2025年;Hamim & Ukkusuri,2024年)并用于基于LLM的多式评价(周等,2025年)。
虽然这些模型已经建立,但我们利用这些模型衡量和指导可提高特定地点指标分数的视觉干预。

blocks.en:
Intervention and Decision Making Digital twins combine city data and simulations to support evidence-based
decision making ( Ghaffarian, 2025 , Cecere et al., 2025 ) .
However, such interventions are domain-specific and expensive to simulate.
Prior works use counterfactual models to understand the inputs’ effect on the model’s prediction ( Jacob et al., 2022 , Zemni et al., 2023 ) . Others use diffusion models to generate counterfactual explanations for black-box models ( Farid et al., 2023 , Chiquier et al., 2025 , Prabhu et al., 2023 ) .
While these works aim to understand model behavior, our goal is instead to use them as real-world actions.

然而,这种干预是针对具体领域的,模拟费用高昂。

虽然这些作品旨在理解模型行为,但我们的目标是把它们作为现实世界的行动。

blocks.en:
Agents for Intervention and Interpretability Remote-sensing VLMs extend instruction-following models to overhead imagery ( Kuckreja et al., 2024 , Zhan et al., 2025 ) , with recent work exploring agentic systems as well ( Xu et al., 2024 , Shabbir et al., 2025 , Kao et al., 2025 ) .
Other works show how agents can design experiments to explain model behavior and discover failure modes ( Shaham et al., 2025 , Schwettmann et al., 2023 ) .
Related works use generative models to simulate street-view interventions and changes in perceived urban quality ( Hu et al., 2025 , Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
Unlike these works, VIDA-Geo formulates urban intervention as a multimodal decision problem.
Moreover, the proposed actions are optimized not only for target urban indicators but also for physical realism and policy feasibility.

其他作品展示了特工们如何设计实验来解释模型行为并发现故障模式(Shaham等,2025年;Schwetmann等,2023年).

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
VIDA-Geo is a multi-agent system that takes an image and an improvement goal instruction to produce grounded intervention proposals consisting of a region, an edit, and a textual description .
Instead of editing the whole image in one step, it decomposes the problem into specialized agents that reason about where to intervene, what to change, which changes are permissible, and how to generate plausible edits.
This creates changes that are localized and atomic and therefore much easier to implement in the real world.
The agentic system includes a multi-epoch feedback loop, where summaries of prior epochs inform the subsequent planning and steering away from repeated failure modes.
blocks.zh:
VIDA-Geo是一个多代理系统,它采用图像和改进目标指示,生成由区域、编辑和文字描述组成的有根据的干预建议。
它没有一步地编辑整个图像,而是将问题分解成一些专门的代理商,这些代理商可以解释干预地点,改变什么,允许哪些修改,以及如何产生可信的编辑.
这造成了局部和原子性的变化,因此在现实世界中更容易实施。
代理系统包括一个多纪元反馈回路,其中对前纪元的总结为后期规划和向导提供了信息,并远离了重复的失败模式.

blocks.en:
The VIDA-Geo pipeline (see fig. 2 ) consists of four specialized agents followed by a scoring and multi-epoch orchestration.
The Planning Agent decides where and what to change; the Policy Agent determines which changes are permissible and which regions are constrained; the Segmentation Agent identifies which pixels correspond to each region of interest; and the Generation Agent creates the visual interventions through prompted inpainting.
Candidate interventions are evaluated by the black-box scorer, and the resulting outcomes are used by the Orchestration mechanism to guide later epochs. Each epoch corresponds to one complete planning-to-evaluation cycle.
We next present these agents.

blocks.en: 3.1 Planning Agent
blocks.zh: 3.1 规划代理人

blocks.en:
Directly editing the entire image is highly unconstrained and may produce unrealistic or infeasible changes.
Therefore, the Planning Agent first identifies and ranks multiple ROIs in the image as candidate intervention locations.
For each ROI, the planner produces ranked spatial coordinates, bounding boxes, and semantic descriptions or keywords required for the downstream segmentation task in section 3.3 .
In later epochs, the planner additionally receives a summary of previous attempts; we describe this feedback mechanism in section 3.5 .
blocks.zh:
直接编辑整个图像是高度不受限制的,可能会产生不切实际或不可行的变化.
因此,规划代理人首先确定并排列了多个区域办事处作为候选人干预地点的形象。
对于每个ROI,规划者会生成第3.3节下游分块任务所需的排名空间坐标,边框,语义描述或关键词.
在以后的时代,规划者还收到以往尝试的摘要;我们在3.5节中描述了这种反馈机制。

blocks.en: 3.2 Policy Agent
blocks.zh: 3.2 政策代理人

blocks.en:
The Policy Agent then determines the physical and semantic constraints governing each ROI.
These constraints fall into three categories: free regions, where any modification is permissible; constrained regions, where edits are allowed but must respect specific rules; and skip regions, which contain critical infrastructure that must remain unaltered.
These constraints determine how each ROI may be modified and are also passed to the Generation Agent in section 3.4 .
For street-view images, the policy agent also enforces general street-scene plausibility, ensuring that buildings, entrances, and other functional elements remain coherent in any edited output. An example of such policy violations can be seen in fig. 5(a) .
blocks.zh:
政策代理人然后确定每个《规则》的物理和语义限制。
这些限制分为三类:自由区域,允许任何修改;受限制区域,允许编辑,但必须尊重具体规则;以及跳过区域,其中包含必须保持不变的关键基础设施。
这些限制决定了每个ROI如何被修改,并在第3.4节中传递给世代代理.
对于街景图像,政策代理人还强制执行一般街景的可信度,确保建筑物、出入口和其他功能要素在任何编辑的产出中保持一致。 这种违反政策行为的例子见于图。 5(a). 联合国

blocks.en: 3.3 Segmentation Agent
blocks.zh: 3.3 分离剂

blocks.en:
The Segmentation Agent receives each ROI from the planner and segments each region using one of several segmentation tools ( fig. 2 (bottom)).
These include text-referred segmentation driven by the planner’s suggested prompt and open-vocabulary models using the planner’s keyword.
When both fail, the agent falls back to point-prompted segmentation models from the planner’s estimated ROI center.
Examples of segmentation failures can be seen in fig. 5(b) and the fallback for segmentation is provided in appendix A .
blocks.zh:
分块剂从规划者那里接收每个ROI,并利用若干分块工具中的一个分块(图2(下方))。
其中包括由规划员建议使用规划员关键词的即时和开放式模式所推动的文本取向分解。
当两者都失败时,该剂会从规划者估计的ROI中心返回到指向的分解模型.
图5(b)显示了分解失败的例子,附录A提供了分解的倒数。

blocks.en:
Segmentation QC Sub-Agent. Because different segmentation methods can produce inaccurate, overly broad, or fragmented masks, each candidate mask is evaluated by an LLM-based quality-control (QC) step that compares the original image against the binary mask.
This evaluation considers three criteria. Coverage checks whether the mask spans the correct target area. Precision estimates how much unrelated regions are excluded. Fragmentation measures how spatially connected the mask is, penalizing, e.g., floating islands.
blocks.zh:
分化QC分机. 由于不同的分化方法可以产生不准确,过于宽,或零碎的口罩,每个候选口罩都通过基于LLM的质量控制(QC)步骤进行评估,将原始图像与二进制口罩进行比较.
这项评价考虑了三项标准。 覆盖范围检查面具是否跨越正确的目标区域. 精确估计了排除多少无关区域。 分解测量了面具的空间连接方式,惩罚了浮起的岛屿等.

blocks.en:
Feedback loop. Failed masks and their QC descriptions are returned to the Segmentation Agent to adjust the mask selection strategy.
The Prompt Suggestion sub-agent revises the segmentation keyword or prompt.
This inner closed-loop mechanism improves poor-quality masks before presenting them to downstream intervention stages.
blocks.zh:
反馈回路. 失败的口罩及其QC描述被退回分块代理,以调整口罩选择策略.
快速建议子代理修改分区关键字或提示。
这种内部闭锁-闭锁机制改进了劣质口罩,然后将其呈现出下游干预阶段.

blocks.en: 3.4 Generation Agent
blocks.zh: 3.4 生成代理

blocks.en:
The Generation Agent receives the input image and all accepted masks to produce edited images intended to improve the black-box indicator.
The images are edited through a mask-and-text-prompted diffusion process, with the Policy Agent ’s constraint annotations injected into the text prompt.
These constraints ensure that edits remain consistent with the physical and functional structure of the scene.
When mask-based inpainting is not feasible, the agent falls back on mask-free text-guided generation models (see examples in appendix A ).
blocks.zh:
"生成代理"接收了输入图像和所有被接受的口罩来制作被编辑的图像,目的是改进黑盒指示器.
图像通过口罩和文字即刻的传播过程进行编辑,政策代理人的制约说明被迅速注入文字。
这些限制确保了编辑与场景的物理和功能结构保持一致.
当基于口罩的涂装不可行时,该剂会回落到无口罩的文本制导生成模型上(见附录A中的例子.

blocks.en:
Generation QC Sub-Agent. Because edits may contain unrealistic, inconsistent, or semantically incorrect modifications, the images undergo a QC step that evaluates three properties. Realism checks whether the edited region can plausibly exist in the real world, flagging, e.g., unnatural textures. Coherence verifies that the edit is contextually consistent with the rest of the image.
Finally, prompt adherence confirms that the generation agent followed the suggested editing prompt. The complete prompts are present in appendix G .
blocks.zh:
生成QC子代理. 因为编辑可能包含不切实际,不一致,或成像错误的修改,所以图像会经过一个QC步骤来评价三个属性. 现实主义检查被编辑的区域是否能够在现实世界中合理存在,被打出旗子,例如非自然纹理. 一致性验证编辑内容与图像其他部分符合背景.
最后,迅速遵守确认生成代理遵循建议的编辑即时。 完整的提示载于附录G。

blocks.en:
Policy compliance check. As previously mentioned in section 3.2 , each ROI is associated with policy constraints, verified using the Generation QC to ensure the physical coherence of edits.
For example,
a residential cluster replacing a retail parking lot is implausible policywise.
Violations are fed back to the generation agent so that it can suggest better-aligned prompts.
In this work, the regulations come from the LLM’s knowledge; however, a future direction would be to improve policy compliance by incorporating city regulations rulebooks .
blocks.zh:
政策遵守情况检查。 如前第3.2节所提及,每个ROI都与政策限制有关,使用"一代QC"进行验证,以确保编辑的物理一致性.
譬如说.
取代零售停车场的住宅集聚区从政策上讲是不可信的。
违章行为被反馈到代代人代理人身上,以便它能够表明更好的对应提示.
在这项工作中,这些条例来自LLM的知识;然而,未来的方向是通过纳入城市条例规则书来改进政策遵守情况。

blocks.en: Feedback loop. Failed outputs, including examples shown in fig. 5(c) , and their corresponding QC feedback are returned to the Generation Agent. The agent analyzes whether the edits lacked realism, broke coherence, or deviated from the prompt. The Prompt Suggestion sub-agent then produces a revised editing prompt for the next generation attempt.
blocks.zh: 反馈回路. 失败输出,包括图5(c)中显示的示例,其对应的QC反馈返回到生成代理. 代理分析编辑是否缺乏现实主义,破坏一致性,或偏离了快取. 即时建议子代理然后为下一代尝试生成修改后的编辑提示.

blocks.en: 3.5 Scoring and Multi-Epoch Orchestration
blocks.zh: 3.5 斯科林和多管弦乐团

blocks.en:
Finally, for each ROI, multiple edited images may pass quality control.
All accepted candidates are scored using the black-box indicator and compared against the original image.
Candidates are ranked based on the difference between the two scores (delta score).
This process is repeated over multiple cycles, with the results from each cycle passed back to the planning agent.
To encourage the agents to identify new regions, produce new masks, and generate alternative edits, all previous candidates and their corresponding delta scores are retained and carried forward to the subsequent cycle.
blocks.zh:
最后,对于每个ROI,多个被编辑的图像可能会通过质量控制.
所有被接受的考生都使用黑盒指示器打分,并与原始图像作比较.
考生根据两个分数(德尔塔分数)的相差排名.
这一过程在多个周期中反复进行,每个周期的结果都传递给规划代理人.
为了鼓励代理商识别出新的区域,出出出新的口罩并产生替代编辑,所有之前的候选者及其相应的三角洲分数都被保留并结转到下个周期.

blocks.en: This accumulated history discourages the system from repeating unsuccessful strategies while encouraging the exploration of diverse editing directions. As a result, this approach yields multiple edited variants from a single input image, each of which adheres to the policy constraints while improving the black-box indicator score.
blocks.zh: 这一积累的历史阻止了该系统重复不成功的战略,同时鼓励探索不同的编辑方向。 因此,这种方法从单一输入图像中产生多个被编辑的变体,每个变体都坚持政策限制,同时提高黑盒指标分数.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en:
In this section, we discuss the implementation details of our agent, present the benchmark and baselines, and show that our multi-agent system provides realistic and grounded interventions.
The implementation details are presented in the appendix ( appendix F ).
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们讨论我们代理人的执行细节,提出基准和基线,并表明我们的多代理人制度提供了现实和有根据的干预措施。
执行情况详情载于附录(附录F)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准

blocks.en:
To perform a comprehensive evaluation with different types of visual geospatial modalities, we sample both aerial images and Street View images.
More specifically, we source high-resolution MapBox aerial images and Google Street View images to evaluate interventions.
blocks.zh:
为了进行具有不同类型视觉地理空间模式的综合评价,我们取样了航空图像和街景图像。
更具体地说,我们源出高分辨率的MapBox航空影像和Google街景影像来评价干预措施.

blocks.en:
For intervention and decision-making, we use black-box indicator prediction models.
For aerial images, we select two models: First is BetaRisk model ( Elallaf et al., 2026 ) , trained to predict fatal-crash risk values.
The second is OpenEarthMap ( Xia et al., 2023 ) used for greenery prediction.
For Street View images, we use the models released with Global Streetscapes ( Hou et al., 2024 ) , which were pretrained on MIT Place Pulse 2.0 ( Dubey et al., 2016 ) , and predict six standard urban perception attributes: safety, lively, beautiful, wealthy, less boring, and less depressing, on a 0–10 scale which we rescale to 0–100.
blocks.zh:
对于干预和决策,我们使用黑盒指标预测模型.
对于空中图像,我们选择两个模型: 第一个是BetaRisk模型(Elallaf等人,2026年),经过了预测致命-碰撞风险值的培训。
二是用于绿化预测的OpenEarthMap(Xia等,2023.
为街道 使用全球街景(Hou等,2024年)发布的模型, Place Pulse 2.0(Dubey等,2016年),并预测6个标准城市认知属性:安全、活泼、美丽、富有、更无趣、更不压抑,

blocks.en:
Because the evaluation requires repeated multi-agent and generative model interactions, we prioritize careful assessment over dataset size.
For each of the 8 indicators,
we score randomly sampled images with the corresponding black-box model and filter
out those already scoring above 90 90 .
From the remaining pool, a VLM selects 100 images per indicator, ensuring diversity in score, geography, and appearance. See appendix K for benchmark statistics.
blocks.zh:
因为评价需要反复的多剂和基因模型相互作用,所以我们优先考虑对数据集大小的仔细评估。
就8个指标而言,
我们用对应的黑盒模型和过滤器随机抽取图像
那些已经得分超过90分的
从所剩池中,一个VLM每个指标选择了100个图像,确保分数、地理和外观的多样性。 基准统计见附录K。

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价计量

blocks.en:
Evaluating interventions is a challenging problem, as VIDA-Geo and baselines can generate a wide range of possible interventions, and it is not directly observable whether these interventions would be effective in the real world.
Therefore, we evaluate such interventions across two complementary axes.
First, the perceptual quality of the generated interventions; by determining whether they appear perceptually realistic.
Second, the policy alignment ; by determining whether the interventions are realistic and actionable from a policy perspective.
blocks.zh:
评价干预措施是一个具有挑战性的问题,因为VIDA-Geo和基线可以产生广泛的可能干预措施,而且没有直接看到这些干预措施在现实世界是否有效。
因此,我们从两个互补轴心来评估这种干预。
首先,所产生的干预措施的认知质量;通过确定它们是否在认知上切合实际。
第二,政策协调;确定干预措施是否切合实际,从政策角度看是否可以采取行动。

blocks.en:
FID-Proxy Through Mahalanobis Distance is used to assess if generated edits remain within the distribution of real images ( Mahalanobis, 2018 ) .
FID requires a set of generated images; however, since we have only one image at a time, we use a proxy (see appendix B ).
blocks.zh:
通过马哈拉诺比斯的FID-Proxy 距离用于评估生成的编辑是否仍然在真实图像的分布范围内(Mahalanobis, 2018.).
FID需要一组生成的图像;然而,由于我们每次只有一个图像,我们使用一个代理(见附录B.

blocks.en:
LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation. Since human evaluation at scale is expensive, we primarily rely on LLM judges ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , using GPT 5.2 and Qwen 3VL ( Singh et al., 2025 , Bai et al., 2025 ) (results in appendix J ).
Each edited image is scored independently (more information in appendix G ) on a discrete 1-10 (later scaled to 1-100) scale across three criteria: • Visual quality : The technical quality of the edit and how natural the image looks. This metric also measures the perceptual quality . • Realism : Assess whether the edited world is physically and semantically plausible.
Objects should have plausible function, material, scale, geometry, and spatial relationships. • Policy preservation : How well the edit preserves the original scene’s structure, layout, function, and geographic identity, while limiting changes to the intended local intervention. A composite judge score is computed as the mean of these 3 LLM-as-a-judge scores.
The latter two metrics assess whether the intervention is plausible and policy-aligned .
blocks.zh:
LLM-as-a-法官评价。 由于人类评价的规模昂贵,我们主要依靠LLM法官(郑等,2023年),使用GPT 5.2和Quen 3VL(Singh等,2025年;Bai等,2025年)(结果见附录J)。
每一个经编辑的图像都单独打分(附录G中的更多信息),分出1-10(后被缩放为1-100)尺度,分为三个标准: 视觉质量: 编辑的技术质量和图像的自然外观. · 现实主义:评估编辑的世界在物理和文字上是否合理。
物体应具有合理的功能、材料、尺度、几何和空间关系。 • 政策保护: 编辑如何保持原景的结构、布局、功能和地理特征,同时限制对当地干预的修改。 综合法官得分作为这3个LLM-as-a-judge的得分的平均值来计算。
后两个衡量标准评估了干预是否合理和政策是否一致。

blocks.en: Visual quality : The technical quality of the edit and how natural the image looks. This metric also measures the perceptual quality .
blocks.zh: 视觉质量 : 编辑的技术质量和图像的自然外观. 这一衡量标准还衡量了观念的质量。

blocks.en:
Realism : Assess whether the edited world is physically and semantically plausible.
Objects should have plausible function, material, scale, geometry, and spatial relationships.
blocks.zh:
现实主义:评估被编辑的世界在物理上和表面上是否合理。
物体应具有合理的功能、材料、尺度、几何和空间关系。

blocks.en: Policy preservation : How well the edit preserves the original scene’s structure, layout, function, and geographic identity, while limiting changes to the intended local intervention.
blocks.zh: 政策保护: 编辑如何保持原景的结构、布局、功能和地理特征,同时限制对当地干预的修改。

blocks.en:
Human Expert Evaluation. We additionally evaluate a subset of our data with seven graduate students and five experts recruited through Prolific ( Prolific, 2026 ) , specializing in urban planning and policy design (see section C.1 ). Evaluators make pairwise comparisons between VIDA-Geo and a selected baseline, providing human validation of perceptual realism and policy compatibility beyond LLM-based evaluation.
We also report high agreement between LLM and expert decisions, suggesting that LLM judges can serve as a scalable and reproducible proxy for human judgments (see section C.2 ).
blocks.zh:
人专家评价. 此外,我们还评估了我们的一个数据子集,其中7名研究生和5名专家是通过Prolific(Prolific,2026年)招聘的,专门从事城市规划和政策设计(见C.1节)。 评价者在VIDA-Geo和选定的基准之间进行对等比较,从而在基于LLM的评价之外,对概念现实主义和政策相容性提供人类验证.
我们还报告LLM和专家裁决之间的高度一致,表明LLM法官可以作为可扩展和可复制的人类判决的代名词(见C.2节)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.3 基线

blocks.en:
Since we propose a new problem of discovering interventions, there are not many relevant strong baselines.
The most closely related method is URSimulator ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , which performs perception-guided iterative editing of street-view images with a diffusion model.
URSimulator tunes text prompts according to predicted human-perception scores but does not adhere to realism and policy.
We additionally adapt methods that generate counterfactuals for interpretability to compare with VIDA-Geo .
DIFFusion ( Chiquier et al., 2025 ) interprets differences between 2 classes by using a diffusion model to transform an image’s class.
It is a differentiable method that edits via gradient optimization instead of a grounded discrete search like VIDA-Geo .
LANCE ( Prabhu et al., 2023 ) utilizes discrete search to find good counterfactuals for a vision classifier.
We use it to find edits maximizing indicator scores.
We also compare our method against NanoBanana 2.5 in the zero-shot setting (NB2.5 (ZS)), where we directly prompt it to edit an image to improve the black-box score.
For fair comparison, all models get the same number of calls to generative models.
blocks.zh:
由于我们提出了发现干预措施的新问题,因此没有多少相关的有力基线。
最密切相关的方法是URS模拟器(Hu等,2025年),它用扩散模型对街景图像进行感知-引导迭代编辑.
URS模拟器会根据预测的人类认知分数来调取文字提示,但并不坚持现实主义和政策.
与VIDA-Geo相比,
DIFFusion(Chiquier等,2025年)通过使用扩散模型来解释2个类之间的差异来改变一个图像的类.
它是一种不同的方法,通过梯度优化来编辑,而不是像VIDA-Geo这样的被基于的离散搜索。
LANCE(Prabhu等,2023年)利用离散的搜索为视觉分级器寻找好的反事实.
我们用它来找到编辑 最大化的指标分数。
我们还在"零发"设定(NB2.5 (ZS))中将方法与"纳诺·巴纳纳"(Nano Banana 2.5)进行比较,直接促使它编辑一幅图像来改进黑盒分数.
为了进行公平的比较,所有模型都得到同样数量给基因模型的呼叫.

blocks.en:
Table 1: Task performance, perceptual quality, and policy alignment for edited images judged with GPT5.2 . Green and red tasks favor higher and lower task scores respectively.
Delta Avg. is signed toward the task objective.
FID-Proxy and judge-score columns report average 95% confidence-intervals . The best judge score for each task and evaluation is boldfaced.
blocks.zh:
表1:根据GPT5.2判断的经过编辑的图像的任务性能、知觉质量和政策一致性。 绿色任务和红色任务分别倾向于高分和下分任务.
Delta Avg. 签到任务目标
FID-Proxy和评分栏平均报告95%的置信间隔。 每项任务和评价的最佳评分都是大胆的。

blocks.en: 4.4 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.4 结果和讨论

blocks.en:
We first test VIDA-Geo quantitatively against the aforementioned baselines.
We observe that it achieves the highest overall performance on both performance axes.
Additionally, we qualitatively show that VIDA-Geo produces multiple plausible interventions that increase the indicator scores and can be used to provide multiple interventions sequentially.
blocks.zh:
我们首先对照上述基线对VIDA-Geo进行定量测试。
我们注意到,它在两个业绩轴上都取得了最高的总体业绩。
此外,我们从质量上表明,VIDA-Geo公司提出了多种可行的干预措施,提高了指标分数,并可用于连续提供多种干预措施。

blocks.en: Can VIDA-Geo produce good interventions? We compare VIDA-Geo against other baselines on all 8 tasks in table 1 . VIDA-Geo consistently obtains the highest LLM-judge scores on 7 tasks, often scoring 15pp higher than the other models, indicating that its edits are judged to be more policy-aligned and visually coherent compared to the baselines.
blocks.zh: VIDA-Geo能否产生良好的干预? 我们比较了表1中所有8项任务的VIDA-Geo与其他基线。 VIDA-Geo在7项任务上持续获得最高的LLM评分,通常比其他模型高15pp分,表明其编辑被判断为与基线相比,其政策更加一致并具有视觉一致性.

blocks.en:
In several tasks, DIFFusion produces the largest changes, such as reducing road risk by 72.8%, but these edits receive much lower perceptual-quality and policy-alignment scores.
As for LANCE, it may change the target indicator in the unintended direction and receive lower LLM-judge scores than VIDA-Geo , suggesting that its interventions are less actionable. The overall results suggest that VIDA-Geo can produce good interventions in terms of perceptual quality and can adhere much better to real-world intervention policies.
blocks.zh:
在一些任务中,DIFFusion产生最大的变化,例如将道路风险降低72.8%,但这些编辑得到的感知质量和政策相协调分数要低得多.
至于LANCE,它可能改变目标指标的出乎意料的方向,并获得比VIDA-Geo较低的LLM评分,这表明其干预不易采取行动。 总体结果显示,VIDA-Geo能够产生良好的视觉质量干预,并能更好地遵守现实世界的干预政策。

blocks.en:
URSimulator only applies to street view images, where it tends to be more conservative in making edits; moreover, it shows a noticeable gap in policy alignment compared to VIDA-Geo .
The zero-shot baseline NB2.5 (ZS) which, unlike VIDA-Geo , is not explicitly designed to search for interventions that satisfy real-world policy constraints.
Nevertheless, it achieves a larger task-directed change than VIDA-Geo .
For example, Lively and Wealthy scores are improved by 39.1% and 50.8%, respectively, compared to 12.7% and 10.2% for VIDA-Geo . However, these larger changes do not consistently translate into high-quality or realistic interventions. The exception is the Greenery task, where NB2.5 (ZS) performs comparably to VIDA-Geo in perceptual and policy-alignment quality.
However, this task is relatively simple, as increasing greenery can often be achieved through simple visual edits such as adding vegetation in empty spaces without requiring complex reasoning.
blocks.zh:
URS模拟器只适用于街景图像,在进行编辑时往往比较保守;此外,它显示出与VIDA-Geo相比在政策协调方面存在明显差距.
与VIDA-Geo不同,零射入量基线NB2.5(ZS)没有明确旨在寻找满足现实世界政策限制的干预措施。
但比起VIDA-Geo,
例如,VIDA-Geo的活泼和财富分数分别提高了39.1%和50.8%,而VIDA-Geo的12.7%和10.2%。 然而,这些更大的变化并没有始终化为高质量的或现实的干预措施。 例外是Greenery任务,其中NB2.5(ZS)在观念和政策对接质量上与VIDA-Geo具有可比性.
然而,这项任务相对简单,因为越来越多的绿化往往可以通过简单的视觉编辑来实现,比如在空地上增加植被而不需要复杂的推理.

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Comparison of intervention outputs from VIDA-Geo vs. DIFFusion for street view (first 2 rows) and aerial inputs (last row).
The interventions provided by VIDA-Geo are more practical and realizable in the real world, e.g., adding bollards and tactile pavements around the intersection in the second.
Moreover, VIDA-Geo can provide text instructions along with the images, unlike DIFFusion, which is more useful to a user.

VIDA-Geo提供的干预措施在现实世界中更为实用并可以实现,例如,在第二个世界的十字路口周围增加柱子和触觉道.
此外,VIDA-Geo可以与图像一起提供文本指示,与DIFFusion不同,DIFFusion对用户更有用.

blocks.en:
Do VIDA-Geo interventions make sense to experts? We also asked domain experts to pairwise compare the VIDA-Geo against DIFFusion and LANCE for the same inputs.
The evaluators were asked, "Which image better reflects the target attribute, which appears more realistic, and which edit would be more feasible in urban planning?".
The results reveal a discrepancy between black-box models and human evaluation.
Against DIFFusion, experts prefer our agent’s outputs 61.3% of the time on perceptual attribute alignment, compared to only 10% of the black-box models favoring VIDA-Geo .
The same trends held against LANCE, where experts preferred VIDA-Geo 86.7% of the time on perceptual attributes and 79.3% of the time on feasibility.
Overall, VIDA-Geo achieves the strongest overall human-aligned performance (See appendix C for more results).
blocks.zh:
VIDA-Geo的干预对专家是否有意义? 我们还要求域专家将VIDA-Geo与DIFFusion和LANCE进行对等比较,以获得同样的投入。
评估者被问道,"哪个图像更好地反映了目标属性,这个属性看起来更现实,哪个编辑在城市规划中更可行".
结果显示了黑盒模型与人类评价之间的差异.
与DIFFusion相比,专家们更喜欢我们代理人的产能 61.3% 的时间在感官属性对齐上,而只有10%的黑盒模型倾向于VIDA-Geo。
与LANCE同样的趋势是,专家们倾向于视觉特征为86.7%的时间和可行性为79.3%。
总体而言,VIDA-Geo取得了最强的整体与人相适应的业绩(更多成果见附录C)。

blocks.en:
While experts disagree with the black-box model, they have a high level of agreement with LLM judges, averaging 88.5% on the realism and 91.6% on the policy-preservation metric (random baselines is 50%).
This indicates that LLMs provide evaluations closely aligned with expert judges and can serve as a scalable proxy for more expensive human evaluations.
blocks.zh:
虽然专家不同意黑盒模式,但他们与LLM法官有高度的一致,平均88.5%关于现实主义,91.6%关于政策保护指标(随机基线为50%)。
这表明,法学硕士提供与专家法官密切配合的评价,可作为更昂贵的人类评价的可扩展代用工具。

blocks.en: Finally, VIDA-Geo ’s interventions can resemble real-world changes. Such changes increase black-box beauty and safety scores by an average of 24.3% and 12.46%, respectively, through interventions such as extended curb geometry, tactile surfaces, and added vegetation. Similar interventions emerge from VIDA-Geo (see appendix M ).
blocks.zh: 最后,VIDA-Geo的干预可以类似于现实世界的变化。 这种变化通过延伸的平分几何、触觉地表和增加植被等措施,使黑盒美和安全分数分别平均增加24.3%和12.46%。 VIDA-Geo也有类似的干预措施(见附录M)。

In the second row, it removes the traffic light, making the region less safe.
In the aerial image, it mainly increases the saturation of the green channel, which is both policy-wise impractical and perceptually unrealistic.

在航空影像中,它主要会增加绿色通道的饱和度,这既从政策上讲不切实际,又从概念上讲不切实际.

blocks.en:

For aerial images, it suggests replacing large parking lots with greener parks, replacing a road bridge with a cycling bridge, and making roads safer, especially for pedestrians (refer to appendix L for more examples).

另一方面,VIDA-Geo提供多种干预(连同其文字描述),看起来现实并易于实施.
对于空中图像,它建议用更绿色的公园来取而代之地取而代之的大型停车场,用骑行桥来取而代之的公路桥,使道路更加安全,特别是对于行人来说(更多例子参见附录L).

Since aerial images represent a larger physical area, even small interventions, such as replacing the bridge, would be a much bigger undertaking for an urban planner.
This explains the relatively lower scores for aerial image tasks in table 1 compared to street-view tasks.
blocks.zh:
由于空中图像代表着更大的实际区域,即使是一些小的干预,如更换桥梁,对于城市规划者来说,也是一种更大的工作。
这解释了表1中航空图像任务的分数与街景任务相比相对较低的原因.

blocks.en:
Can VIDA-Geo do sequential edits? In fig. 4 , we show the results of applying VIDA-Geo sequentially to outputs from a prior run.
These sequential edits produce interventions that align with policy and increase the indicator score more than a single edit.
For example, in the top row, VIDA-Geo first adds a mural, then expands the buildings, and finally adds texture to the window.
The boring score decreases from 53% to 17%, while with single-edit we get the score to 40% at best.
This suggests that when urban planners seek larger changes, VIDA-Geo can propose sequential edits that progressively improve the target indicator while largely preserving quality and policy alignment.
As shown in fig. 4(b) , goal-aligned scores increase with iterations, while LLM-judges metric decrease slightly, suggesting a reasonable trade-off. Additional sequential analysis can be found in appendix D .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion, Limitations, and Future Work
blocks.zh: 结论、限制和未来工作

blocks.en:
We presented a new problem setup moving beyond monitoring towards testing interventions and decision-making.
Testing and evaluating successful intervention is a challenge; therefore, we proposed an evaluation benchmark of 8 different tasks across aerial and street view images, consisting of 800 images.
We also proposed new metrics to evaluate the quality of such interventions, both perceptually and policywise.
To tackle the problem, we introduced VIDA-Geo a multi-agentic method that suggests good grounded interventions.
We believe such intervention can be used as decision support to real-life urban planners and policymakers when deciding to change a physical space in the real world.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了一个新的问题,从监测转向测试干预措施和决策。
测试和评价成功干预是一项挑战;因此,我们提出了航空和街景图像8个不同任务的评价基准,由800个图像组成。
我们还提出了新的衡量标准,从概念上和政策上评估此类干预措施的质量。
为了解决这一问题,我们采用了VIDA-Geo的多代理方法,建议采取有根据的干预措施。
我们认为,在决定改变现实世界的实际空间时,这种干预可用作对现实生活中城市规划者和决策者的决策支持。

blocks.en:
Limitations and Future Work: Since our work introduces the new problem of visual intervention for geospatial support, we present the first method as a solution.
We believe there is substantial room for improvement.
For example, in the current system, edits generated by FLUX, especially for aerial images, frequently fail quality checks, leading to over-reliance on NanoBanana.
Additionally, replacing closed-source models as agents with open-source counterparts is possible but degrades quality significantly.
Furthermore, the current method relies on multiple mask/edit quality checks to ensure good outputs, which could be reduced with better segmentation and editing tools.
Finally, this work does not directly encode full zoning law, engineering standards, or construction budgets.
However, it is intended as an early-stage decision support for urban planners and policymakers, rather than an implementation system.
The generated edits and their indicator scores provide visual proxies that can help experts explore and compare candidate interventions, and we hope that future work will include such constraints to further improve the intervention framework.
blocks.zh:
局限性和今后的工作:由于我们的工作提出了对地理空间支持进行视觉干预的新问题,我们提出了第一种解决办法。
我们认为,还有很大的改进余地。
例如,在目前的系统中,由FLUX产生的编辑,特别是用于航空图像的编辑,经常会失败质量检查,导致过度依赖纳诺巴纳纳.
此外,用开源对等设备取代闭源模型是可能的,但质量会大幅下降。
此外,目前的方法依靠多种口罩/编辑质量检查,以确保良好的产出,通过更好的分块和编辑工具,可以减少这些产出。
最后,这项工作没有直接编码完整的分区法,工程标准,或建筑预算.
然而,它旨在为城市规划者和决策者提供早期决策支持,而不是一个执行系统。
生成的编辑及其指标分数提供了可帮助专家探索和比较候选干预的可视代用词,我们希望今后的工作将包括这些制约因素来进一步改进干预框架.

blocks.en: One concern with sequential editing is the accumulation of artifacts from one iteration to the next, as some acceptable edits may already receive lower LLM-Judge scores after the first iteration and continue to degrade with additional edits. To further analyze this behavior, we iteratively edit 10 inputs per Street View metric and stop when no acceptable edit passes QC or if the edited image reaches the desired goal for the metric (9.0 for increasing metrics and 1.0 for decreasing metrics). We then evaluate the outputs using the LLM-Judge metrics discussed in section 4.2 , and the results can be seen in fig. 7 . This showcases the trade-off between continual editing and the LLM-as-a-Judge scoring. Across tasks, the first iteration produces the largest improvement in the target indicator and generally the highest average LLM-Judge scores, but the following iterations indicate a slight drop in perceptual quality and policy alignment scores. Despite this decline, the average LLM-Judge scores at the final iteration remain above 5.0, suggesting that the resulting edits remain reasonably realistic and policy-aligned.

blocks.en:
In section 1 , we mention that a model can be considered an Implicit Digital Twin if it has the ability to not only make correct predictions on the in-distribution test data similar to the training data but also on counterfactuals that may be out-of-distribution.
Here we present brief qualitative evidence that the black-box models we have chosen perform fairly well on counterfactual edits. Figure 8 , shows changes to the score from these black box model when certain changes are made.
While exact score is hard to interpret, the relative increase or decrease is logical.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: Figure 8: Counterfactual scene edits and corresponding predictor outputs. VIDA-Geo generates alternative versions of the same street-view image through two distinct editing directions. As vegetation is removed and the environment becomes less maintained, the black-box "beauty" predictor assigns progressively lower scores. The consistent and interpretable score changes suggest that the predictor captures meaningful scene attributes under counterfactual interventions, supporting its use as a component of a world model.
blocks.zh: 图8:反事实场景编辑和相应的预测输出. VIDA-Geo通过两个不同的编辑方向生成同一街景图像的替代版本. 随着植被被去除,环境得到的维护也越来越少,黑盒"美丽"的预测器会分配出逐渐较低的分数. 一致和可解释的分数变化表明,预测器在反事实干预下捕捉到有意义的场景属性,支持它作为世界模型的一个组成部分来使用.

blocks.en:
The pipeline integrates four models, FLUX-Fill Black Forest Labs (2024) , LISAt Quenum et al. (2025) , SAM Kirillov et al. (2023) , and SAM3 Carion et al. (2026) , which serve as local REST microservices.
Region planning and all quality-control agents use GPT-5.1 Singh et al. (2025) .
Semantically constrained regions rely on Gemini 2.5 Flash Comanici et al. (2025) , also referred to as NanoBanana 2.5 (NB2.5), which edits via scene-level instruction rather than masked pixel replacement.
All the cloud calls to GPT-5.1 and NB2.5 carry no local GPU requirements.
The thresholds used in the quality check steps using the LLM judge were 0.7; the number of trials to mask and edit each region is limited to 3 trials per epoch. We set the steps to 30 and guidance to 20 for FLUX.

blocks.en: All experiments ran on a NVIDIA RTX 5000 Ada GPU with 32GB of memory. blocks.en: Ablation analysis was completed by disabling some of VIDA-Geo ’s sub-agents, using a subset of 10 images sampled uniformly from each task. The analysis particularly focused on the Policy Restrictions (restrictor) module, the Prompt Suggestion (suggestor) sub-agent, and the Generation QC and Segmentation QC sub-agents. Around 38.3% of the outputs of the models with disabled agents do not produce an image that improves upon the baseline score. Additionally, disabling the QC sub-agents causes a significant drop in scores from 77.7% to 67.1% for the Generation Edit QC and 64.2% for the Segmentation Mask QC in the average LLM-as-a-Judge score, as detailed in table 12 .

blocks.en: Appendix P Broader Impact of this Work
blocks.zh: 附录 P 宽度 这项工作的影响

blocks.en: VIDA-Geo can support urban planning by making proposed interventions easier to visualize, compare, and prioritize before costly real-world deployment. It is the first of its kind to help in decision making to support engineers and urban planners in planning and modifying regions with multiple indicators in mind. At the same time, the system should not be treated as a replacement for community engagement, expert review, or detailed engineering studies. Because the generated edits and indicator scores depend on pretrained models, they may inherit geographic, socioeconomic, or cultural biases, and visually plausible interventions may still be legally, financially, or physically infeasible. There is also a risk that such tools could be used to optimize for superficial visual improvements rather than deeper structural needs.
blocks.zh: VIDA-Geo可以支持城市规划,使拟议的干预措施更容易在费用高昂的现实世界部署之前进行可视化、比较和优先排序。 这是第一次帮助决策,以支持工程师和城市规划者规划和修改地区,同时考虑多种指标。 同时,该系统不应被作为社区参与、专家审查或详细工程研究的替代。 由于所生成的编辑和指标分数取决于经过预先训练的模型,它们可能继承地理、社会经济或文化偏见,视似合理的干预可能仍然在法律上、经济上或实际上不可行。 还有一种风险是,这些工具可用来优化表面视觉改进,而不是更深层次的结构需要。
